method: node bootstrap of the official hierarchical WRMSSE: the (revenue weight, per-node RMSSE) pairs of the committed blend's valid hierarchy nodes are resampled with replacement, weights renormalized per draw, weighted mean recomputed; percentile 2.5/97.5 over the resamples. Bounds the node-sampling uncertainty of the single test window's blend level — NOT a paired interval for the vs-floor gap and NOT across-origin uncertainty
seed_rule: m5_track.SEED (42) + 3501 — distinct from the erratic-refinement bootstrap offsets (3301/3401)
